opening.argument: The video explains how CoinPilot’s copy-trading features work: viewers are shown controls for mirroring trades, while the speaker describes setting parameters so the system can select traders and execute trades automatically. The speaker does promote signing up and completing a first copy trade for a stated reward, but also advises independent research, and the description warns of possible loss and disclaims any guaranteed outcome. Requests to like, subscribe, and enable notifications are ordinary audience engagement. On this record, the promotional offer does not turn the feature review into evidence of required payment, credential sharing, or assured returns.
